Module 1:  Agency, education and innovation (1 hour)
Many girls are still single they are not schooling and they rarely have any power to make any decisions and still rely on their parents.
As girls in this community, many of us do not even approach our fathers directly we have to go through our mothers if we have anything to communicate to our fathers.
Some of our friends are married and do not have power or freedom to make decisions as they are told that they should respect their husbands.
Some of those married fear their husbands they say that if you keep on making your own decisions then.
In the family there are 2 people and one can not make decision on her own
Some of the youth are oppressed because they are young and parents think that they are not wise enough.
Can not make a decision on their own because youth are not given chance to make important decisions and they remain future leaders.
Not many think about education in this community some youth are discouraged because they do no find employment.
Some have no fees and parents do not think it is important many left school because they see that those who went to school are not employed it is a waste of time.
They think it is waste of time to go to school better get married.
Parents have no interest to send girls to school.
Some especially girls say the educated are enough so much so that even if we get educated we are not going find jobs.
Previously parents encouraged the girls to go to school not now, now the girls say what is the use for being educated if those who have gone to form 4 are still at home.
Some boys are sent by parents to take care of livestock such as goats and cattle
Parents find it is not useful for children to go to school
Some boys and girls decide to get married soon they become of age.
Boys

Parents see no benefit for a girl child to go too far with education hence girls left in standard 4.

The good class is form 4 the coming years those who do not reach college or university will not be able to stand on their own.

They will be on good job if they are educated.

Beans are easily marketable and no need for fertilizer even maize previously they could grow without fertilizer now you need fertilizer. Previously there was no seed for soya that is why we had to plant beans.
The chickens do not need special care
Chickens have many chicks at once so that one can benefit easily.

Such as plucking groundnuts
Picking beans is done by girls only
girls think they could not do the activities that boys do and they belittle themselves
Parents actually divided the roles that particular jobs for boys and girls and as we grow older, we do follow what parents ascribe.
If the crop was harvested from the boys plot then there is no problem to sell.
If he is at his parents home he will still need to tell parents because all crops grown remain property of the family.
- No problem on part of boys.
- Even soya there is no problem the girl would freely sell the soya.
- They work together with parents and in this case it is not possible for both to sell.
When the boy and girl with parents they all work in a plot as decided by parents.
It is the girl that wants to have own plot but you have to work at parents plot first.
You beg from parents and they refuse or accept.
It depends on the size of the garden and also on your strength
Boys and girls
It is possible to have different plots but there must be consent from the parents who are the ones to decide the division of the plots.
It depends on the cooperation between boy and girl.
In case of men do not help women and like wise because there is special reason for such.
If the girl is Determined she can do the work without asking for additional labour
If you are unable to the do work you put pieceworker (waganyu) or a loan arrangement
but if you have money you pay immediately.
Relatives or parents may help – but most of the times we don’t want them to assist because they may demand payment or take control of the plot.
They also look at the behavior of the girl assistant if they think the girl is not obedient they rarely assist.
If you have never grown the crop before, you do ask from friends or you go and ask those who are already growing the crops.
If you are married you ask your husband to give consent.

Gender
